records.entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
records.name_as_stated: World Bank Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership (RAMP)
records.detail: The Central Bank of Kenya splits its reserve bond holdings into an internally managed portfolio and an externally managed one run under the World Bank's Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership. At 30 June 2026 the RAMP portfolio held KShs 48,859 million of fixed income securities against KShs 925,723 million run in-house, and it earned KShs 1,946 million of interest in the year. The same holding is also labelled 'World Bank managed portfolio-RAMP' in the note on amounts reclassified to the income statement.
records.source_title: Central Bank of Kenya Annual Report & Financial Statements 2025/26, Notes 4 (Interest income), 10 (Changes in fair value of investments) and 15 (Debt instruments measured at fair value through other comprehensive income)
records.quote: Externally managed portfolio – (World Bank Reserve Advisory & Management Partnership)-(RAMP) 1,946 2,855

records.name_as_stated: International Bank for Reconstruction and Development (IBRD)
records.detail: Under an Agreement on investment management and consulting signed on 8 December 2010 between the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development and the National Bank of Moldova, extended from 1 February 2016, the IBRD acts as the bank's investment manager for a portion of the foreign reserves, limited to 20% of them, investing in US dollar securities issued by the US Treasury, government agencies and supranational institutions. At 31 December 2024 the externally managed securities stood at MDL 7,579,148 thousand, 7.49% of foreign currency reserves, against MDL 4,054,858 thousand and 4.29% a year earlier.
records.source_title: National Bank of Moldova, Financial Statements for the year ended 31 December 2024, note on foreign currency securities measured at FVOCI and Note 4.1 Financial risk (liquidity risk)
records.quote: IBRD serves the Bank’s advisor and investment manager for a portion of foreign reserves, limited to 20% of the foreign currency reserves.

records.entity: World Bank Treasury Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP)
records.detail: The Bank of Mongolia lists a 'RAMP Investment Account' among its holdings of debt securities, holding MNT 928,574 million at 31 December 2021 and MNT 930,566 million a year earlier. The bank explains the account by saying that, to improve and strengthen foreign currency management, it has been implementing the World Bank's resource management improvement consulting and resource management project since 2011. The report describes the arrangement as consulting plus resource management and gives no separate statement that the World Bank runs the money day to day.
records.source_title: Bank of Mongolia Annual Report 2021, Audited Financial Statements, Note 10 Investments in debt securities
records.quote: Reserves Advisory and Management Program (RAMP) Investment Account Assets In order to improve and strengthen foreign currency management the BOM has been implementing World Bank’s “Resource management improvement consulting and resource management” project since 2011.

records.detail: Central Banking's asset-manager award citation says the Central Bank of Eswatini stopped running this money in-house and outsourced it to Crown Agents Investment Management from October 2023, seeking better returns, and that the bank doubled the size of the mandate at that point. The citation gives no figure for the amount under management and no later review date.
records.source_title: Central Banking Awards, Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management
records.quote: outsourcing it to CAIM for better returns from October 2023

records.detail: Central Banking's asset-manager award citation says the Central Bank of the Solomon Islands has worked with Crown Agents Investment Management since 2023, and that 95% of the bank's allocation of IMF Special Drawing Rights is now in the firm's hands. The citation gives no cash figure for the portfolio.
records.source_title: Central Banking Awards, Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management
records.quote: Now, 95% of the bank’s SDR allocation is in the hands of CAIM.

records.detail: Central Banking's asset-manager award citation says the Bank of Jamaica first handed Crown Agents Investment Management $250 million of its IMF Special Drawing Rights to run, and that the portfolio has since been doubled. The citation gives no date for the first allocation and no figure for the current size.
records.source_title: Central Banking Awards, Asset manager: Crown Agents Investment Management
records.quote: The bank first allocated $250 million of SDRs to CAIM, a portfolio that has since been doubled.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Lesotho Annual Report 2024 — section 2.2 Reserves Management (pp. 31) and the credit-risk counterparty tables in the notes to the financial statements
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: Section 2.2 describes the policy objectives and an 'active approach to reserves management' and names nobody. The counterparty tables carry the rows 'Bank of N.Y (RAMP)', 'Crown Agents' (GBP 181/146 and GBP 203 / USD 4,296), 'World Bank RAMP' 54,703, 'United States-RAMP' and 'RAMP T Bills' 214,280. No sentence anywhere in the report says any of these bodies manages a portfolio, so under the no-upgrade rule nothing is filed. The separately published audited financial statements (CBL_AFS) were not readable — see needs_a_hand_check.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Barbados Annual Report 2024 as tabled in Parliament — Note 21 Financial Risk Management, and the foreign securities tables that follow it
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The note refers once to 'the Investment manager' in the context of divesting a security that loses its S&P rating, and names no firm. Total foreign securities BDS$2,442,518 thousand are broken out by asset category (asset-backed, mortgage-backed, treasuries, government, supranational, corporates, agencies) with no manager attached to any slice. This is the separately published audited statement set an earlier round had not read.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: SARB Annual Report 2024/25 — risk-management oversight section and the reserves-management governance section; plus Gold and Foreign Exchange Reserves Management Investment Policy, sections 6.7.5–6.7.7 and 9.1.4
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: 'External fund managers manage a portion of the FX reserves to enhance the internal reserves management capabilities and diversify risk and return.' The investment committee Resmanco 'approves the appointment and termination of external fund managers', the SARB hires them under its procurement policy, and they must present annual portfolio reviews. Neither document names a single firm.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Maldives Monetary Authority Annual Report 2024 — Note 9.2 Investments in securities at FVOCI and Note 9.3 Investments in securities at FVPL
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: 'This balance represents the investments in debt instruments by the Authority and its appointed external asset managers under the investment policy.' USD 65 million was with the Authority's external asset managers at 31 December 2024 (2023: USD 65 million), and a USD 10 million CNY mutual fund had been bought via an external asset manager in 2022 and sold on 12 August 2024. Balances with external asset manager: 3,252,278 (2023: 9,114,639). No firm is named anywhere in the report.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Cayman Islands Monetary Authority Annual Report 2025 (tabled, hosted at parliament.ky) — Currency Reserve Assets note, part (a) Investments
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: 'The investment portfolio is managed by independent fund managers in accordance with investment guidelines established by the Board of Directors of the Authority', with fees calculated on market value and payable quarterly in arrears and either party able to terminate on thirty days' notice. No fund manager is named.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Bermuda Monetary Authority Annual Report 2021 — Note 14 Notes and coins in circulation, including the Section 19 external-assets table
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: Crown Agents appears only in the list of asset categories the Bermuda Monetary Authority Act permits the Authority to count toward its external-asset cover — 'or (f) balances with Crown Agents'. The table of assets actually held at 31 December 2021 shows only overseas bank balances ($140,156) and specified securities ($80,642), with no Crown Agents balance and no manager named.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Croatian National Bank Annual Report 2022 — Figure 4.4, structure of international reserve investment portfolios
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The portfolio structure chart has a slice labelled 'External manager' alongside the dollar-denominated investment portfolio, the euro-denominated investment portfolio and the two held-for-trading portfolios, so the HNB does delegate a slice. 'External manager' is the only mention in the whole report and no firm is named.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Narodowy Bank Polski, 'Foreign exchange reserve management' page on nbp.pl (the bank's own standing description of how the reserves are run)
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The page describes NBP investing the reserves itself and names no external manager. The only outside parties are the banks holding short-term deposits — 'A fraction of the reserves are maintained in the form of short-term deposits at banks with a high credit standing' — and the international institutions and government agencies that issue the securities NBP buys. A depositary and an issuer are not managers. NBP's annual-report FX reserve chapter remains unread — see leads_not_opened.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Bank of Albania Financial Statements 2024 — notes on the objectives of foreign reserve portfolio management and on credit risk monitoring
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The notes set out 'the objectives of the portfolio management ranked by priority, and the principles' and say that 'the portfolio manager and the risk unit monitors the creditworthiness of each' counterparty. Both roles are inside the bank; no outside firm, the World Bank or the BIS appears as a manager anywhere in the statements.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Iceland Annual Report 2022 — liquidity-risk section of the financial statements and the note on shareholdings in the BIS
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: 'The vast majority of the Bank's foreign exchange reserves are invested in highly liquid securities, deposits in central banks, and deposits with the Bank for International Settlements.' A deposit is not a managed portfolio, and the BIS also appears only as an entity whose capital shares the bank owns (1,070 shares at cost). No external manager is named.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: National Bank of Ukraine Annual Report 2023 — international cooperation section
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The only asset-management name in the document is 'J.P. Morgan Emerging Markets Credit Conference', listed among events NBU staff attended alongside a CNB/IMF conference and the Rebuild Ukraine Business Conference. Attending a conference is not a management mandate. No external reserve manager appears in the report.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Montenegro, Decision on International Reserves Management No. 116/24 (English text on cbcg.me)
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The decision sets out eligible instruments, counterparty and rating limits for the international reserves and contains no provision on external managers, on delegating a portfolio, or on custodians. The words manager, custodian, entrust and delegate do not appear in the English text. CBCG's periodic reserves reports were not opened — see leads_not_opened.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Natural Resource Fund Annual Report, December 31 2024 (Ministry of Finance) — Chairman's report and Notes on financial risk management
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: RAMP appears once, as 'a three-day BOG/Reserve Advisory and Management Partnership (RAMP) Workshop with the World Bank officials' that the Board and Committees attended at the Bank of Guyana's invitation. That is training, not management. The report elsewhere refers to 'the Investment Manager of the Bank of Guyana', which is internal. No outside firm is named.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Bahrain Annual Report 2023 — payments and financial-infrastructure section
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The only asset-manager name in the report, JPMorgan, appears in a payments pilot overseen by the CBB that transferred 'US dollars deposited with JPMorgan'. A deposit account used in a payments pilot is not a reserves mandate. No external reserve manager is named anywhere in the report.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Sri Lanka Annual Report 2022, Full Text Volume II — Financial Markets Department section and the outsourcing passages
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: Every 'outsourcing' reference in the volume is to human-resources services, mail management, pharmacy and other premises services, or to supervisory directions on outsourcing by licensed finance companies. The phrases external fund manager, externally managed and external asset manager do not appear. No outside firm is named as managing reserves.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Banco Central de Bolivia, Informe de Administración de las Reservas Internacionales 2024 (INFORME RIN 2024)
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: This edition says the reserves are 'administradas por el BCB' — managed by the central bank — and contains no instance of administradores externos, gestores externos, administración externa or any named firm. Earlier editions of the same report named three firms, so the 2014, 2015 and 2020 editions are worth re-reading — see leads_not_opened.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: National Bank of the Kyrgyz Republic Annual Report 2025 — international cooperation section and the table of liabilities to international financial institutions
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: The World Bank appears as a creditor line (652.4 to 930.1, by year), as a counterpart in technical work and scholarship programmes, and in the abbreviation list. The BIS appears only as host of the Committee on Payments and Market Infrastructures. No external manager, RAMP account or named firm appears.

confirmed_blank.document_and_section: Central Bank of Uzbekistan Annual Report 2025 — international cooperation section and the chapters citing external data
confirmed_blank.what_it_said: Every World Bank reference is either a data source for forecasts and commodity prices, the joint IMF–World Bank FSAP assessment, or technical-assistance missions on the payments and regulatory framework. The BIS appears only as the developer of a standard. No external reserve manager, RAMP account or named firm appears.

leads_not_opened: Central Banking's asset-manager award citations are the cheapest unexploited vein on this row. The Crown Agents Investment Management citation named three client central banks (Eswatini, Solomon Islands, Jamaica) and the Amundi citation named one with a figure and a start date (Central Bank of Colombia, $1.7 billion active fixed income, started May 2023 — already covered by Colombia's own report). The equivalent citations and interviews for BlackRock, PIMCO, State Street, JPMorgan, Goldman Sachs, Wellington, Franklin Templeton and the 'Reserve manager' award series on centralbanking.com were not opened and each may name clients the same way.

NBP's own FX reserve chapters, which the bank's summary page does not cover: nbp.pl/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Chapter-15_Financial-and-equity-position-and-financial-result-of-NBP-for-2023.pdf and the 2022 equivalent answer 200 with a near-empty body to curl (5,996 bytes), and Raport_Roczny_2023.pdf and Raport-roczny-2022-EN-_16_10.pdf were not tried at all.
